text.p: - Russia's Constitutional Court may have to consider the case of the new $10 border tax to be introduced shortly.
- Many Russian women are ready to become surrogate mothers to well-off foreigners for as little as 6,200 stg.
- President Boris Yeltsin offers a union to Belarus's President Alexander Lukashenko.
- President Yeltsin's offer of a union to President Lukashenko sounds in fact very much like an ultimatum to speed up reforms or face the consequences.
- President Boris Yeltsin, seeing he is losing political intiative inside the country, has fired a sure shot, offering unification with Belarus.
- Vagit Alekperov, chairman of Russian oil giant Lukoil, says in an interview Azeri early crude oil will be pumped through the pipeline in Chechnya as early as this year.
- Russia's health protection system which is supposed to be free for all fails to fulfil many of its duties.
- President Yeltsin's new sick leave made his press secretary Sergei Yastrzhembsky crack the whip at journalists for misreporting Boris Yeltsin's health problems.
